verdict.rationale: Neon gives agents and users programmatic deletion and some expiry controls. The MCP surface includes create, update and delete project, plus recovering a deleted project and deleting or resetting branches. neon.ts supports per-branch TTLs (e.g. `{ ttl: "7d" }`) for auto-expiring branches, and snapshots can be scheduled. Unclaimed agent-provisioned projects expire after 72 hours, and project cleanup is described as fully automated via the API. Missing for 10: documented controls over the history/restore retention window, guarantees and timelines for purging deleted data and backups, and any retention-policy or compliance documentation or independent corroboration.
